marketMood: Risk-off: AI safety call rattles chip stocks globally while Saudi pipeline shutdown drives oil above $107, with pivotal FOMC and BOJ decisions looming this week.

upcomingEvents.event: Bank of Japan Policy Meeting Begins

topStories.headline: Amodei, Altman and Musk Call for AI Development Slowdown, Rattling Chip Stocks
topStories.summary: Top AI company leaders — including Anthropic's Dario Amodei, OpenAI's Sam Altman, and Elon Musk — jointly urged a pause in advancing AI models to allow safety measures to catch up, sending Nasdaq 100 futures down more than 1%.
topStories.marketImpact: Chip stocks ↓: NVDA, AMD, MU, INTC under pressure; Nasdaq 100 futures ↓ >1%; S&P 500 futures ↓ 0.6%

topStories.headline: Saudi Arabia Shuts Critical East-West Oil Pipeline After Drone Strikes; Brent Surges Toward $108
topStories.summary: Drone attacks originating from Iraqi territory damaged Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline — the primary bypass route for crude avoiding the Iran-blockaded Strait of Hormuz — prompting a full shutdown and removing up to 700,000 bpd from global supply.
topStories.marketImpact: Brent crude ↑ toward $108/bbl; WTI ↑ near $103; energy stocks ↑; stagflation risk ↑

topStories.headline: FOMC Meets This Week With Markets Pricing Over 50% Odds of a Rate Hike
topStories.summary: The Federal Reserve's two-day meeting begins Tuesday, with markets now pricing more than 50% odds of a 25bp hike to 3.75–4.00% after Chair Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole speech and a solid August jobs report.
topStories.marketImpact: Bond yields ↑; TLT ↓; USD ↑; equities cautious ahead of Wednesday decision

topStories.headline: Nikkei 225 Falls 1.7% to Six-Week Low; SoftBank Drops 12%, Kioxia -8.6%
topStories.summary: Japan's benchmark index dropped to 62,922 as AI and semiconductor stocks bore the brunt of selling after the global call to slow AI development, with SoftBank Group leading losses.

topStories.headline: Hang Seng Drops 2.1% in Worst Week in Over a Year; Tencent -3.7%, SMIC -7.9%
topStories.summary: Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index fell 533 points to 25,473, closing out its worst weekly performance since 2024 as mainland tech names bore the brunt of a global AI-driven selloff, with Z.AI Co. losing 10.8%.

topStories.headline: Alibaba's Record HK$80B Share Placement Funds AI Push But Dilution Concerns Weigh
topStories.summary: Alibaba completed its largest-ever Hong Kong share placement — raising HK$80B to fund AI data centers and computing infrastructure — but markets remain cautious about dilution and the scale of capital expenditure.
topStories.marketImpact: 9988.HK watch ↓ on dilution overhang; AI capex debate intensifies across sector

topStories.headline: Bank of Japan Meets Thursday–Friday; Rate Hike Possible as Inflation Exceeds 2% Target
topStories.summary: The BOJ's two-day policy meeting begins Thursday with inflation running above its 2% target, raising the prospect of a rate increase from the current 0.75–1.0% range — a decision that could sharply move the yen.
topStories.marketImpact: USD/JPY watch; Japanese financials ↑ if hike; exporters ↓ on yen strength; 9984.T, 8035.T sensitive
